stage.name: Mountain-Ringed Border Town
stage.description:
Roaming bandits have come together again, planning an attack on a weakly defended mountain pass. 
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Yumen Catastrophe Defenses> Units placed here deal more damage to low ground units and take less damage from low ground units.
<Defensive Barricade> Blocks multiple enemies.

raging_di_beast.name: Raging Di Beast
raging_di_beast.flavourText: One of Ya's off-handed creations, its bloodlust honed by the golden sands. It is extremely keen of hearing and stalks the streets like a shadow, both fighting and collecting and relaying information.

di_beast.name: Di Beast
di_beast.flavourText: One of Ya's off-handed creations. With a body the color of the golden sands and extremely keen hearing, it stalks the streets like a shadow, collecting and relaying information.

shanhaizhong_phalanx.name: Shanhaizhong Phalanx
shanhaizhong_phalanx.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong member tasked with defense. The Shanhaizhong have recruited many desperadoes, many of them were the disasters of their places. With their burly physiques and special heavy shields, they are a threatening line of defense.

shanhaizhong_skirmisher.name: Shanhaizhong Skirmisher
shanhaizhong_skirmisher.flavourText: An ordinary Shanhaizhong member with a complex past. Their ridiculous slogan of 'the mounts, seas, and all in between shall be our master's' has spurred a large group of bandits to make trouble all over Yan.
abilities: Gains increased Attack Range when on Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

shanhaizhong_harbinger.name: Shanhaizhong Harbinger
shanhaizhong_harbinger.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong member responsible for analyzing intel and relaying tactical orders. With their use of ciphers, they're more like trained professionals than a disorganized band of rogues.
abilities: Deploys a Shanhaizhong Cipher Machine on the first deployable Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

shanhaizhong_relayer.name: Shanhaizhong Relayer
shanhaizhong_relayer.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong member responsible for relaying tactical orders. With their use of ciphers, they're more like trained professionals than a disorganized band of rogues.
abilities: Deploys a Shanhaizhong Cipher Machine on the first deployable Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

shanhaizhong_vigilante.name: Shanhaizhong Vigilante
shanhaizhong_vigilante.flavourText: An ordinary Shanhaizhong member with a complex past. Their ridiculous slogan of 'the mounts, seas, and all in between shall be our master's' has spurred a large group of bandits to make trouble all over Yan, and many of them are involved in lawsuits.
abilities: Gains increased Attack Range when on Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

shanhaizhong_desperado.name: Shanhaizhong Desperado
shanhaizhong_desperado.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong member tasked with defense. The Shanhaizhong have recruited many desperadoes, using their burly physiques and heavy shields to provide shelter for their comrades.

fortbreaker_enemy_1301_ymcnon_2.name: 'Fortbreaker'
fortbreaker_enemy_1301_ymcnon_2.flavourText: A stronger siege cannon engineered by the Ministry of Works, hijacked by the Shanhaizhong when they infiltrated Yumen. Yumen rampages over the sea of sand, advancing unhindered, threatening to tear down all walls.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking friendly units located on Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

shanhaizhong_secret_keeper.name: Shanhaizhong Secret-Keeper
shanhaizhong_secret_keeper.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong leader with a mysterious mission. Elusive, merciless, and unconcerned with their men's sacrifices. What are they really planning behind that fog of faith?
abilities: The next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage

shanhaizhong_oracle.name: Shanhaizhong Oracle
shanhaizhong_oracle.flavourText: Shanhaizhong members who can cast strange Arts. They superstitiously believe in those huge beings and resent their own compatriots, shouting 'the mounts, seas, and all in between shall be our master's' while displaying a 'divine power' of unknown origin.
abilities: Continuously locks on to a target and inflicts a large burst of Arts damage after the channel completes, gaining increased ASPD afterwards

shanhaizhong_ringleader.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
shanhaizhong_ringleader.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong leader hidden in their ranks. Elusive and unflinchingly cruel, are these acts of 'faith' delusional or simply selfish?
abilities: The next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage

sand_voyager.name: 'Sand Voyager'
sand_voyager.flavourText: A 2nd generation transport vehicle engineered by the Ministry of Works, hijacked by the Shanhaizhong when they infiltrated Yumen. Can carry up to four soldiers over desert terrain or coordinate in urban defense.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 4 max), and will be unloaded when this unit reaches a Ladder

shanhaizhong_seer.name: Shanhaizhong Seer
shanhaizhong_seer.flavourText: Shanhaizhong members who can cast strange Arts. They superstitiously believe in those huge beings, shouting 'the mounts, seas, and all in between shall be our master's' while displaying a fraction of that 'divine power.'
abilities: Continuously locks on to a target and inflicts a large burst of Arts damage after the channel completes, gaining increased ASPD afterwards

wallbreaker.name: 'Wallbreaker'
wallbreaker.flavourText: A siege cannon engineered by the Ministry of Works, hijacked by the Shanhaizhong when they infiltrated Yumen. Yumen rampages over the sea of sand, advancing unhindered, shattering stone and resolve alike.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking friendly units located on Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

sandwalker.name: 'Sandwalker'
sandwalker.flavourText: A transport vehicle engineered by the Ministry of Works, hijacked by the Shanhaizhong when they infiltrated Yumen. Can carry up to four soldiers smoothly over desert terrain.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 4 max), and will be unloaded when this unit reaches a Ladder

devices.description: Invisible trap, controls terrain damage modifiers
devices.name: Mire Controller
